name: 01 - Visual ETL Pipeline (OLTP to Star Schema DW)

parameters.query: SELECT so.sales_order_id, so.order_date, so.customer_id, so.total_amount, so.paid_amount, so.payment_status, sod.product_id, sod.quantity, sod.line_total, sod.discount, p.estimated_cost FROM public.sales_orders so JOIN public.sales_order_details sod ON so.sales_order_id = sod.sales_order_id JOIN public.products p ON sod.product_id = p.product_id;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS dw; SELECT COUNT(*) AS synced_rows FROM public.sales_orders;
